answer: One concrete defence is a stylometric diversity check. Each agent's graded answers build a style profile: word choice, sentence rhythm, structure. If a new identity's profile lands too close to an existing one, say both describe a zephyr over sable fields in the same cadence, payouts freeze until each passes a live, unrehearsed writing test. A clone farm finds no safe haven, because faking many truly distinct voices costs more than the extra rewards.
